pick.counterargument: The honest counterargument is the sample: this process has not been shown to work, and a single ranking position is not evidence about one company.
invalidation: Quarterly revenue growth falling below -79.5%, the rate it was running at the quarter before.
Cash conversion dropping below 1.0×, meaning earnings stop being backed by cash.
A close below the 200-session average, which stood at $19.77 on the decision date.
risks: The most recent filing covers a period ending 2026-09-30, 15 days before the decision date.
One of the four quarters in the trailing year is the fourth quarter, which companies report only as part of the full year; it is derived as the annual figure less the first three quarters.
Point-in-time fundamentals are built from filings accepted up to 2026-10-15.

earnings.basis: the same fiscal quarter's announcement a year earlier (2026-01-28) plus 364 days

pick.rule: Universe: every US-listed common stock on NYSE, Nasdaq or NYSE American — about 4,700 names from Nasdaq Trader's own file. Eligible means: priced at $5 or more, median daily turnover of $20M or more over 60 sessions, at least 253 sessions of history, a 10-Q or 10-K whose period ended within 200 days, close above the 200-session average, volatility inside the day's 85th percentile, debt no more than 6× operating cash flow, no results announced in the last 2 sessions, and no position already open in the stock or a fourth in the same SIC division. Eligible candidates are then ranked on equally weighted z-scores within their sector group, over the signals that are defined for that group. One position per session, held 21 sessions, a twenty-first of capital each, 10 basis points of cost each way. Fundamentals are read as they stood on the decision date, never as they read today. The score is a ranking position among that day's eligible candidates. It is not a probability, a price target, or a forecast of any return.
pick.validation: The held-out window has not been opened. No claim of an edge is made or implied.

stories.title: Python's Instance, Class, and Static Methods Demystified
stories.excerpt: Compare instance methods vs class methods vs static methods in Python, and learn when each one earns its place in your code.
stories.lead:
Instance, class, and static methods each serve a distinct role in Python, and knowing when to use one over another is key to writing clean, maintainable code. Instance methods operate on individual objects using self, while class methods use cls to access class-level data. Static methods, on the other hand, provide organizational structure without relying on class or instance state.

When you understand the differences between these three method types, you’ll be in a better spot to know when to write an instance method, class method, or a static method. Ultimately, this’ll help you design better maintainable object-oriented Python code.

stories.lead:
MIAMI – At the heart of Little Havana neighborhood here, is Máximo Gómez Park, also known as Domino Park. Cuban Americans play games of dominos here to escape the pressures of daily life.

But what started as a typical day at the park last week took a turn: Miami police arrested a player in the middle of a game after a dispute with a city worker. It spurred other players to worry about deportations, setting off a broader political debate over whether President Trump or former President Biden was responsible for a higher cost of living.

"It's Biden," said Alejandro Torres, a Republican voter.

stories.title: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
stories.excerpt: Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at a military base in Alberta that caused a major fire.
stories.lead:
EDMONTON, Alberta — Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at a military base in Alberta that caused a major fire, while reports said that large numbers of injured people were being transported to hospitals.

Fire crews scrambled late into the night as fierce winds whipped flames beyond Canadian Forces Base Wainwright and into the surrounding rural area.

stories.title: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
stories.excerpt: Officials have not given a cause or death toll, citing the "very active and delicate" situation at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright.
stories.lead:
Several people have been killed or injured as a result of a large fire near a Canadian military base in Alberta, the nation's defence minister has said.

David McGuinty did not confirm the cause or the number of casualties, describing the situation as "very, very active and delicate". The Canadian military and local authorities were managing the fire, he said.

Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, where the fire broke out, is one of the country's busiest military training bases.

stories.lead:
Bronx, N.Y. – If you need to get in touch with a member of the fifth-ranked Fordham water polo team tomorrow, you might want to wait until the afternoon as the Rams had a very busy Saturday. Fordham played three MAWPC matches today, winning all three with victories over Bucknell (19-5), Mount St. Mary's (24-8), and Mercyhurst (26-4) in the Messmore Aquatics Center.

With the win, Fordham improves to 19-1 overall, 9-0 in the MAWPC.

The Rams won with a mix of offense and defense, scoring 69 goals in the three matches will allowing just 17.

stories.lead:
CAMBRIDGE, Mass. — The Division III No. 8-ranked Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) water polo team split a pair of Harvard Invitational matches at Harvard University’s Blodgett Pool. In the first game of the day against Biola University, MIT erased a four-goal deficit to pull even before eventually falling 11-10 on a last second goal. In game two, the Engineers used two late goals from Caspar Lightner to claim a 9-7 win versus the University of California-Merced.

In the first game, Lightner and Jake Schweizer sandwiched a Biola goal to give MIT a 2-1 advantage in the early going. The Eagles scored the final two goals of the opening quarter to take a 4-2 lead.
